messages:
sasha: Seeing a small but reproducible client-side parse error on SSE when we flip routes during the canary. Chunks get interleaved and the client throws a JSON parse error. Repro steps below.
kevin: ugh. is this the proxy-multiplexing case or something on the runtime?
maria: telemetry spike at 2:13pm: partial_chunk_parse_errors +12% for the canary route. also a bump in 502s.
ops: deploy-bot pushed canary v5 -> 5% at 14:12 :rocket: (was 1%)
sasha: repro curl (simple):
```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \ 
  "https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/stream?model=xx-canary" \ 
  | head -n 20
```
sometimes you get half a JSON event then a second route's chunk appended before the newline, e.g. `{"type":"delta","text":"he"}` + `{"type":"delta","text":"llo"}` -> client sees `..."he"{"type"...` and fails.
kevin: that sounds like proxy connection reuse/racing where two backends write to the same TCP stream during a route swap. we should check keepalive/connection pooling semantics.
maria: related billing concern: when clients reconnect we replay tokens and I think we double-bill partial payloads in some cases. need a guard.
devx: console UX: current streaming error dashboard aggregates by model family, making canary noise invisible. we need per-route streaming parse error heatmap + sample payload to triage.
ops: rolling back to 1% for now while we triage.
sasha: workaround for clients: be more lenient in parser and accept concatenated JSONs separated by `{` as start of next event, but that's brittle. we should fix server-side.
kevin: short-term server fix ideas: 1) ensure proxy flushes chunk boundary with an explicit delimiter header (e.g. `sse-chunk-id` + flush) 2) enforce sticky routing during resume and canary swaps 3) add per-connection write lock to avoid interleaving.
maria: for billing: propose resume token include last-billed-offset + server-side idempotency check to avoid replay charges.
devx: console rollout UX change: pause canary if streaming parse errors exceed threshold for 3 consecutive minutes, and show example failing payload in the trace panel.
kevin: i'll open a PR for proxy change (add flush + per-connection lock) and add counters: `partial_chunk_count`, `interleaved_chunk_count`, `resume_idempotency_fail`.
product: can we make the console auto-pause canaries on streaming parse regressions? that would avoid noisy rollouts. cc @devx
ops: agreed, we'll patch the rollout controller to watch the new metrics once they're emitted.
sasha: attaching a small packet capture and logs in the thread. i'll also add a minimal nodejs repro client.
maria: prioritization: short-term sticky routing + billing guard; medium-term framing protocol for streaming (explicit framing header or length-prefixed events).
kevin: timeline: proxy patch + metrics by EOD tomorrow, canary auto-pause PR by end of week.
product: thanks — please add a note in the rollout changelog and a console banner for affected customers.
sasha: thanks all. i'll follow up with traces once we get the proxy patch rolled out. :thumbsup:
